Use cases

Grok Bot use cases — start with one job

Pick one reversible job. Name the Bot after that job. Paste a brief that says what to return and when to stop. Do not stand up twelve Bots on day one.

Copy a starter job From X Skills GitHub

How a first job should look

Official Get started asks for five parts. Community writeups that actually shipped work use the same shape.

One outcome

A review list, a cited brief, or a keep-or-switch card — not “be my assistant.”

Named sources

Inbox, CRM view, attached file, or the site you will take over to sign in.

A hard stop

Do not send, enroll, delete, book, or pay until you say so. Description beats a later “stop.”

Copy a starter job

Original briefs on this site, written to the official pattern: own one outcome, start as read-and-prepare, keep money and sends behind approval. Open the official use-cases for the longer role list.

Five minutes

Warm-up: one document

A cited brief from a file you attach. No connector. No login.

I attached one document. Give me (1) five bullets on what it says, and (2) every date, decision, and open question with a page or section cite. Leave the file unchanged.

Chief of Staff

Morning attention list

What changed, what needs you, and what can wait. One door, not twelve Bots.

You are my only door today. Review yesterday across my inbox, calendar, and meeting notes against the priorities I pasted. Return only items that map to those priorities. For each: source, why it matters, the next step, and whether I owe a decision. Do not send messages, create more Bots, or change meetings.

Ops

Inbox to drafts

A sorted pile plus replies in your voice. You still hit send.

Walk this inbox. Group messages into needs me, can wait, and junk. Draft replies in my voice for the first group only. Do not send, archive, unsubscribe, or delete.

Sales

Outbound research pack

Scored accounts and review-ready drafts. No enroll, no send.

Research the accounts in this list (or this CRM view). Score each against the ICP I attached and any recent intent you can show. Name up to three contacts per account and draft email plus LinkedIn in the style samples. Skip anyone already in a sequence. Return a review list. Do not send or enroll anyone.

Life

Declutter audit

A numbered list of unused mail, Drive clutter, and paid subs. Approval before any cut.

Audit email, Drive, and paid subscriptions. Return a numbered list of what looks unused and the evidence. Wait for my yes before you delete, unsubscribe, or spend.

Life

Travel hunt

Keep-or-switch options with fees. The last click stays yours.

Find the upcoming trip in my calendar or the confirmation I pasted. Compare the booked fare and stay with three cheaper options, including change fees. Recommend keep or switch, with the total after fees. Do not book, cancel, or enter payment.

Skills worth installing first

Most “Grok Bot skill” repos on GitHub are 0–1★ dumps. These have a documented Grok Bot or Cursor-marketplace install path and recent maintenance (checked 2026-09-04). A skill you save after two good runs still beats a random pack. Full catalog: Tools.

Compound Engineering · 24.8k★

Install once in the Cursor marketplace. Grok Bot inherits that plugin library. Do not clone the repo onto the Bot computer.

superpowers · marketplace

Largest general skill pack Grok Bot can load through Cursor: plan, debug, write.

Aaron Marketing Skills · 2.7k★

120 marketing skills as an 8-bot staff on Grok Bot. Named teammates, not a SKILL.md dump.

Grok Ship · 156★

Grok-Bot-native software factory. Tell a Bot to follow GROK_SHIP.md. Scout vs ship; you merge.

Gojiberry Sales OS · 93★

Outbound pack with a hosted MCP. Intent, enrich, LinkedIn, replies — do not invent contacts.

Vercel plugin · 275★

Official Vercel connector: deployments, logs, domains. Watch the OAuth redirect thread.

xAI plugin marketplace · 211★

Official .grok-plugin catalog. Browse here, then install through Cursor / Grok Bot plugins.

Skip the 195-skill catalogs. Repos that only ship a pile of SKILL.md files with no stars, no license review, and no Grok Bot install steps stay off this list.

High-star GitHub — not the official app

Self-hosted alternatives and companion repos. They are not xAI’s Grok Bot. Side-by-side: official vs OpenMausBot, rakazo, gawkbot, OpenClaw. Reconstructed clients and grok.com prompt dumps are omitted on purpose.

OpenMausBot · 2.1k★

Self-hosted alternative with a VM the bots can use. Apache-2.0. Not the official client.

rakazo · 1.9k★

Bring your own model and sandbox. Web, Electron, Expo. Apache-2.0.

gawkbot · 1.3k★

Local-first: npx gawkbot. Approval gate on every send. Not xAI’s cloud computer.

opengrok · 417★

Model picker inside the official Grok Bot app. Keys stay on your machine. Third-party.

plugin-marketplace · 211★

Official xAI .grok-plugin catalog that Grok Bot inherits under Cursor plugin policy.

botdirectory.ai · 160★

Paste-ready agent prompts for Grok Bot and Rakazo. Community directory.

awesome-grok-bot · 220★

Upstream CC0 list this catalog is built from.

First week

1

Install and sign in

Desktop or phone. Cursor account. Have one real login ready — empty demos burn the week.
2

One Bot, one job

Short name. Paste a starter brief. Watch the computer. Take over for password and 2FA — never paste those into chat.
3

Correct, then save a skill

Fix the output once. Ask it to keep that format. Save the method. All Bots share one computer.
4

Routine only after two good runs

Schedule the digest or the research pack. Tests do real things. Keep writes behind approval.

Do not start with money, customer sends, or twelve Bots. Nate’s “eight hours, twelve Bots” is a review, not an ops plan. Debbie’s flights case stopped at the last click. Gergely’s refunds case still needed a human before money moved.
